children: UK construction contractor's full-year revenue rose 3%, meeting analyst expectations
Adjusted operating profit grew 21.9%, beating analyst expectations
Company announced new £15 mln share buyback programme
Galliford Try expects similar revenue growth and further margin expansion in FY27
Company says 90% of FY27 and 62% of FY28 projected revenue is already secured
Galliford Try reiterates 2030 targets: revenue above £2.2bln, divisional margin at 4.0%
INFRASTRUCTURE GROWTH - Co said Infrastructure revenue rose 7.7%, driven by strong performance in Highways and early design fees in Environment
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Co attributed higher margins to improved bidding, quality project delivery, and disciplined commercial and operational management
ACQUISITIONS AND INVESTMENTS - Co said acquisition of Nene Valley Fire and Acoustic and new fabrication facility were margin accretive and enhanced specialist capabilities
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Galliford Try Holdings PLC is GBp690.00, about 12.7% above its September 16 closing price of GBp612.00
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
